name: Zakelijke mediation
description: Neutraal Nederlands mediationverslag dat standpunten, feiten, betwistingen en voorlopige uitkomsten uit elkaar houdt.

sections.title: Standpunten van partijen
sections.objective: Represent each party's stated position separately and neutrally, attributing it without judging truth or motive.

output_fields.label: Partij
output_fields.description: Partij of vertegenwoordiger aan wie het standpunt is toegeschreven.

sections.title: Erkende feiten
sections.objective: List only facts explicitly accepted by all relevant parties; do not promote an uncontested-sounding allegation to an agreed fact.

sections.title: Betwiste beweringen
sections.objective: Record allegations and disputed claims with attribution and the opposing response; never state an allegation as established fact.

output_fields.label: Reactie
output_fields.description: Belegde reactie van de andere partij.

sections.title: Voorstellen
sections.objective: List settlement or process proposals and identify the proposing party without implying acceptance.

sections.title: Concessies
sections.objective: Capture explicit concessions or changes in position and attribute each one to the offering party.

output_fields.label: Aangeboden door
output_fields.description: Spreker of partij die de concessie deed.

sections.title: Voorlopige afspraken
sections.objective: List tentative agreements while clearly preserving their provisional nature and any stated conditions.

sections.title: Onopgeloste kwesties
sections.objective: Summarize issues that remain unresolved and each party's supported position at the close of the session.
